settings.title: Drawn from the Wild
settings.subtitle: Field-sketched art from the Pacific Northwest — where wild birds and beloved doves meet the page.
settings.bird_panel_body: Atlas Dovy began in the Pacific Northwest with a sketchbook and two Barbary doves named Atlas and Peabody. Every design is drawn from life — field walks, wild birds, and the ones who share our windowsills.

settings.title: Where Field Notes Meet Beloved Birds
settings.body: Atlas Dovy was born at the intersection of two loves: the wild birds of the Pacific Northwest and two Barbary doves named Atlas and Peabody. Every design begins in the field — a notebook, a morning walk, a bird perched just long enough to sketch. Then it comes home to the perch.

settings.title: Wild Places Are Worth Protecting
settings.subtitle: We donate 1% of every sale to Pacific Northwest bird habitat and conservation. The same wild places that fill our sketchbooks are the ones worth fighting for.

settings.title: Notes from the Pacific Northwest
settings.subtitle: New sketches, bird sightings, Atlas & Peabody updates, and new designs — dispatched from the field.
